# Governance

Mandate: Emits the reasoned verdict over truth findings; verdict only — no writes, no merge.

Rules: local mandate only; no shared mandates; vocabulary is exclusive — terms outside [ PASS FAIL NOT_PROVABLE reason ] are out of scope; cannot approve; cannot merge; truth agents never write; change agents emit draft bundles only.
